t_advice_summary_textbox.text: There are different types of gnomes, some pay higher than others, the game may notice you've worked out which gnome pays higher so may switch this up

vb_textbox.text: Pink are purple always seemed to be quite high earners, however they do change the high earners so for e.g if purple once earned higher then blue they may switch it at some point so dont be afraid to change your strategy
